architecture.mechanism: abnormal information warning algorithms for velocity and route management
architecture.intervention: Implement a diagnostic software patch that monitors ACC and ABS sensor signal continuity and applies an abnormal information warning algorithm to distinguish between transient electrical noise and genuine system faults before illuminating the dashboard warning lights.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduction in intermittent warning light illumination caused by transient electrical spikes or momentary communication losses, ensuring lights only activate for verified persistent faults.
architecture.falsification_test: Simulate intermittent voltage drops and signal noise on the ACC and ABS sensor lines of a 2021 Honda CR-V test bench; verify that the updated software suppresses warning light illumination during transient events while still triggering correctly for sustained fault conditions.
